draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) reported that salience pre-filtering reduced the share of news summaries containing an unsupported entity by 31% relative to an unfiltered summarizer, across three news summarization benchmarks.
rationale: P1 describes the salience pre-filtering method (scoring, threshold 0.35, training data) but contains no reported reduction percentage, no "31%", and no mention of three benchmarks or unsupported-entity rates. The 31%/three-benchmark figures appear nowhere in the package. The claim is unsupported.
